chunks.text: Alright, next is Gemini. This one shall have a quick mind. Okay, how quick?
They don't just hear what you said, they hear what you meant, and they'll have a response before you finish talking.
K. so they think fast? No, they think ahead. Now make them strongly opinionated. K. also.
They'll argue your point, and still not agree with it. That's confusing. Give them the ability to read the room perfectly. Nice.
They'll know exactly what not to say. K-4D-1 They'll say it. They can be the life of the party.
Give them a voice. And make them keep everything to themselves.
The question is like you're saying something in the opposite. I'm just... It depends on which one's thinking. Which one? Ah yes. I put two in there.
